comments.body: The same problem How to solve it

I am currently facing an issue with GitHub Copilot in VS Code since last night. When I try to select certain models in the Copilot interface, it displays the message “Contact your admin,” even though this is my personal GitHub account and I am not part of any organization or enterprise account. My GitHub account has an active GitHub Student Developer Pack, and Copilot Pro benefits are enabled. Previously, everything was working correctly and I was able to use Copilot without any issues. I am currently working as an intern, and Copilot has been very helpful for my development tasks. However, after the recent updates, several Copilot models are no longer accessible in VS Code and show the “Contact your admin” message. I have already tried multiple troubleshooting steps, including restarting VS Code, reinstalling the Copilot extensions, signing out and signing back into GitHub, clearing credentials, and verifying that my Copilot Student plan is active. Despite these steps, the issue still persists. Could you please check if there is any problem with my Copilot account configuration or if this change is related to a recent update affecting personal or student accounts? Thank you for your time and support. I would really appreciate your help in resolving this issue. vs code version -1.111
